reviews.text: I like using this before bed. it’s a bit sticky but that makes it last the night. the scent is light but pleasant. it’s a decent size but it’s not actually as big as it seems- the bottom of the container tapers so it’s widest at the top but gets smaller. I still think it will take me a good several months to get through it. I’m interested in getting other flavours of the lip sleeping pack too.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意瞓前用。佢有啲黏，但咁樣就可以留到成晚。味道淡但好聞。樽嘅大小算合適，不過其實冇睇落咁大——樽底收窄，所以樽口最闊、越向底越細。我估仲要用好幾個月先用得晒。我都有興趣試吓呢款唇部睡眠膜嘅其他口味。

reviews.text: I have been using this SKINFOOD Honey Sugar Lip Sleeping Pack for three days to give my honest opinion. I really liked it; it has completely done its job perfectly. It is an excellent lip mask to use while sleeping that leaves lips incredible, very soft, hydrated, and without any dryness in the morning. Additionally, it has a very pleasant sweet fragrance and a comfortable texture. Without a doubt, I would buy it again as soon as I run out. I highly recommend it
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款 SKINFOOD Honey Sugar Lip Sleeping Pack 三日，想畀個真誠嘅意見。我真係好鍾意，佢完全做到應有嘅效果。呢款係一款好出色嘅瞓眠唇膜，第二朝雙唇好軟、好水潤，冇乾燥感。另外，佢有好舒服嘅甜香味，質地都好舒服。毫無疑問，用完我會再買。我非常推薦。

reviews.text: I am absolutely in love with this lip sleeping pack! The combination of manuka honey and black sugar leaves my lips feeling incredibly soft, plump, and deeply hydrated by the morning. It has a rich, nourishing texture that stays on all night without feeling uncomfortably sticky. Plus, it smells amazing! If you struggle with chapped or dry lips, you definitely need to try this. Will 100% repurchase!
reviews.zh: 我真係好愛呢款唇部睡眠膜！麥盧卡蜂蜜同黑糖嘅配搭，令我第二朝嘅唇變得超級軟熟、飽滿，而且深層保濕。質地豐富滋潤，成晚都留喺唇上，又唔會覺得好黏。而且香味好好聞！如果你嘅唇容易乾裂，一定要試吓。我一定會百分之一百再買！

reviews.text: I have very dry and chapped lips during the winter, and I feel like I have to constantly apply Vaseline so they don't dry out. This mask worked extremely well from first application, softening my lips so I could exfoliate without bleeding. It has a strong honey scent, but it's not so strong that you can smell it when it's on the lips.
reviews.zh: 冬天我嘅唇非常乾，而且會乾裂，我覺得要不停搽凡士林先唔會乾。呢款唇膜第一次用就效果好好，令我嘅唇軟咗，所以我可以去死皮而唔會流血。佢有濃郁嘅蜂蜜香味，但唔會濃到喺唇上都聞到。

reviews.text:
I don’t use lip masks as overnight lip masks, but as regular moisturizer because nothing works for my dry lips. This and the Laneige overnight lip masks are the ONLY things that work for me. It’s amazing.

I feel that the Laneige lip mask soaks in a bit more. Whereas this one is maybe a bit thicker and stays on quite a bit longer. I can’t really pick and say which one I prefer more, but this one is the one I turn to when I feel the original pink laneige lip mask isn’t working for me. I use laneige when I feel like I need something that sinks in more, and this one when I need something to sit there a bit longer. It also has a very faint honey fragrance that most likely won’t reach your nose when you wear it.
reviews.zh:
我唔係晚上當唇膜咁用，而係當日常保濕霜用，因為乜嘢都對我嘅乾唇冇效。呢款同 Laneige 嘅晚間唇膜，係唯一對我有效嘅產品。真係好正。

我覺得 Laneige 嗰款吸收得多啲。而呢款可能厚身少少，留喺唇上都長啲。我真係揀唔出邊款更鍾意，不過當我覺得原本嘅粉紅色 Laneige 唇膜效果唔好時，我就會轉用呢款。我需要吸收快啲嗰種時用 Laneige，需要留耐啲嗰種時就用呢款。佢仲有非常淡嘅蜂蜜香味，搽咗之後多數唔會聞到。

reviews.text: I like this mask as it is nourishing and doesn’t clog pores around my lips as some of other lip products do. So I recommend using it. Also I don’t like the honey scent but this one is subtle so I don’t mind. And it goes long way however I sometimes use it during a day, not only as a sleep mask
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢款唇膜，因為佢滋養，唔似一啲其他唇部產品咁會堵塞嘴唇周圍嘅毛孔。所以我推薦用。另外，我唔太鍾意蜜糖味，但係呢款味道好淡，所以我唔介意。而且佢好夠用，不過我有時會日頭用，唔係只係當睡眠唇膜。

reviews.text: I’ve been loving the SKINFOOD Honey Sugar Food Mask Lip Sleeping Pack! The texture is rich but not sticky, and it melts beautifully into the lips. I apply a small amount before bed, and by morning my lips feel incredibly soft, smooth, and nourished. The honey scent is deliciously comforting, and the formula gently exfoliates while deeply hydrating. It’s a must-have if you struggle with dry or chapped lips – especially during colder months!
reviews.zh: 我一直好鍾意 SKINFOOD Honey Sugar Food Mask Lip Sleeping Pack！質地豐富但唔黏，好服帖咁化開喺唇上。我瞓前搽少少，第二朝我嘅唇會感覺非常軟滑、順滑，而且好滋潤。蜂蜜香味香甜又舒服，配方溫和去角質，同時深層保濕。如果你嘅唇乾裂，尤其係天氣冷嗰陣，一定要有呢款！
